name: Login gives stock classes the Character Advancement state and every character the realm's game mode
contract: The client creates its Character Advancement player record and pending build only from SMSG 0x0725 (u32 active spec, u32 spec count); without it the Character Advancement window of a Hero or stock-class character aborts its setup and shows an empty page. The server sends 0x0725 and the known-entries list 0x0726 once the client sets its active mover (CMSG_SET_ACTIVE_MOVER) after entering the world. SMSG 0x090B (u32 mask) sets what GetCustomGameMode reports and resets on every glue screen, so every login must send it, also on a realm without custom game modes. Expected: a Warrior and a CoA-class control each receive one 0x090B at login, nothing from Character Advancement before the active mover, then one 0x0725 and one 0x0726.

steps.label: The Warrior learns the realm's game mode at login
No Character Advancement state before the active mover
The Warrior's client sets its active mover
The control's client sets its active mover
The Warrior receives the active specialization
The control receives the active specialization
